name: fiera-google-ads-rules
description: Open Google Ads rules from Fiera, packaged as skills: API and GAQL gotchas, keywords and negatives, copy, assets and PMax, bidding and measurement, a read-only setup guide, an account context builder and a read-only account audit. Rules are written in Spanish.

interface.shortDescription: Google Ads rules for AI agents
interface.longDescription: These are the rules Fiera's agents follow every day in the Google Ads accounts we manage: API behaviours the documentation doesn't mention, readings of data that mislead, and decisions we've seen go well and badly. Two skills help you start in read-only mode and build a context file for your account, and an audit skill reviews an account without changing anything. The rules are written in Spanish.
defaultPrompt: Audit my Google Ads account in read-only mode
